cards.gloss_en: a wild uncultivated area of land
cards.ex_en: We got lost in the wilderness for two days.
cards.ex_cn: 我们在荒野里迷路了两天。

cards.ex_en: This lake is infinitely deeper than that one.

cards.gloss_en: the small exact details of something
cards.ex_en: Please write down all the particulars of the accident.
cards.ex_cn: 请写下事故的所有细节。

cards.ex_en: The men carried two hatchets to cut wood.
cards.ex_cn: 那些人带了两把小斧去砍柴。

cards.ex_en: Verily, he spoke the truth.
More money does not necessarily bring happiness.
Their dwelling stood on a small hill.
cards.ex_cn: 他们的住所建在一座小山上。

cards.gloss_en: set up firmly by driving into the ground
cards.ex_en: We pitched the tent beside the lake.
cards.ex_cn: 我们在湖边支起了帐篷。

cards.gloss_en: picked out one from a group
cards.ex_en: The teacher singled him out for praise.
By my reckoning, we still have ten miles to go.
cards.ex_cn: 照我估算,我们还有十英里要走。

cards.gloss_en: twigs woven into baskets or furniture
cards.ex_en: She kept the bread in a wicker basket.
cards.ex_cn: 她把面包放在柳条篮里。

cards.gloss_en: a thin soup made by boiling meat
cards.ex_en: Mother made some hot broth for the sick child.
cards.ex_cn: 妈妈给生病的孩子做了些热肉汤。

cards.ex_en: His countenance grew pale with fear.

cards.gloss_en: a person's natural temper or character
cards.ex_en: She has a cheerful disposition.
He has an extraordinary memory.
The sailors feared the island was full of cannibals.
cards.ex_cn: 水手们担心岛上都是食人者。

cards.gloss_en: a telescope for viewing distant things
cards.ex_en: He watched the ship through a perspective glass.
A tall bearded man opened the door.
cards.ex_cn: 一个高个子大胡子男人开了门。

cards.gloss_en: people from one's own country or people
cards.ex_en: He longed to see his countrymen again.
cards.ex_cn: 他渴望再见到自己的同胞。

cards.ex_en: No one foresaw the storm.

cards.gloss_cn: 履行(职责);(过去式)卸下、解除
cards.gloss_en: carried out or fulfilled (a duty); also unloaded
cards.ex_en: The workers discharged the goods from the ship.
cards.ex_cn: 工人们把货物从船上卸了下来。

cards.ex_en: He came from a seafaring family.
cards.ex_cn: 他出身于一个航海世家。

cards.gloss_cn: 铁石心肠的、冥顽的;(过去式)变硬
cards.gloss_en: callous and unfeeling; also made hard
cards.ex_en: The mud hardened in the sun.

cards.gloss_en: the raised front part of a ship
cards.ex_en: The sailors slept in the forecastle.
If we lose this ship, we are undone.
cards.ex_cn: 要是丢了这船,我们就完了。

cards.ex_en: They hauled the boat up onto the beach.
The birds flew northward in spring.
He would not acknowledge his mistake.
cards.ex_cn: 他不肯承认自己的错误。

cards.ex_en: They sailed westward for many days.
cards.ex_cn: 他们向西航行了许多天。

cards.gloss_en: having come to know someone or something
cards.ex_en: I soon got acquainted with my new neighbours.
cards.ex_cn: 我很快就跟新邻居熟了。

cards.gloss_en: strong coarse cloth used for sails
cards.ex_en: The sails were made of strong canvas.
cards.ex_cn: 那些帆是用结实的帆布做的。

cards.gloss_en: the act of being set free or bought back
cards.ex_en: He worked hard for the redemption of his debts.
cards.ex_cn: 他努力工作以还清债务。

cards.ex_en: He built a clever contrivance to catch fish.
cards.ex_cn: 他造了个巧妙的装置来抓鱼。

cards.gloss_en: a bundle or quantity of something
cards.ex_en: A parcel arrived for me this morning.

cards.gloss_en: a bird, especially one kept for food
cards.ex_en: They kept fowl for their eggs.

cards.gloss_en: a person who fires a large gun
cards.ex_en: The gunner fired at the enemy ship.

cards.gloss_en: guided the course of a boat or vehicle
cards.ex_en: He steered the boat toward the shore.
A strong gale blew all night.

cards.gloss_cn: 决意;下定决心(现在分词)
cards.ex_en: She kept resolving to study harder.
We used the water sparingly.
She sat by the window in a pensive mood.

suspect.ctx: ...having thus discharged his duty in warning me against measures which he knew would be to my hurt...
suspect.issue: 书中是 discharged his duty=履行/尽(职责),回读"卸下;释放"通不通——父亲不是卸货或释放什么,而是尽到了劝告之责
suspect.suggest: 此处义应为"履行;尽(职责/义务)",建议增补该义项或另立卡

suspect.ctx: the worst and most hardened wretch among us would confess both the danger and the mercy
suspect.issue: 书中 most hardened wretch 作形容词=铁石心肠的/怙恶不悛的(道德麻木),非物理"变硬;硬化",且 pos 标 v. 也不符
suspect.suggest: 此处义应为"冷酷无情的;顽固不化的(adj.)",建议增补该义项或另立卡
